transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… hi. I guess I came in because I’ve been having this thought that keeps bothering me. Like, even when I know I did the safety check on my cab, I keep thinking maybe I missed something and someone could get hurt… or my boss might think I lied about checking it.

I know that probably sounds a bit much, and I don’t want to make it seem worse than it is, but it kind of sticks in my head while I’m driving, or even when I’m trying to study, and I can’t really shut it off.

When you have these thoughts about possibly missing a safety check, do you find yourself doing something repeatedly, like checking again or going over it in your mind, to try to make sure everything is okay?

Yeah… I do, kind of. I mean, I try to tell myself I’m just being careful, because it’s a taxi and people are trusting me, you know?

But before I take a ride, I’ll go around the car checking the tires, the lights, the doors, the meter, the paperwork… and then sometimes I’ll do it again. If it doesn’t feel like I checked it properly, I sort of have to start over. I’ve even taken pictures sometimes, just to prove to myself I did it.

It’s embarrassing to say, but it can make me late, even when someone’s waiting. I know that probably sounds excessive… I’m not trying to waste time or anything. I just feel like I can’t leave until it feels okay.
Do these thoughts and checking behaviors cause you a lot of stress or interfere with your daily life, like your work or time with family and friends?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t want to make it sound like I just can’t function or anything, but it has been causing problems.

I’ve lost some rides because I couldn’t get on the road fast enough, and my boss has warned me about it a couple times. I know he needs me to be on time, and I’m trying, it’s just… the checking eats up more time than I mean for it to.

And then with studying for my CDL, I keep pushing it back because by the time I’m done catching up from work delays, I’m already behind. I don’t really see my friends much anymore either. Not because I don’t want to, just because I’m either working late or trying to make up for the time I lost earlier.
